name: Wet conductive chain
description: Two crawlers and plated enemy near flooded generator.
given: Current from machine enters a chain of wet tiles, metal target on connected wet cell; ally on dry tile.
when: Circuiter energizes machine; Vanguard pushes enemy into flood.
then: shock propagates to connected wet tiles maximum 8
metal enemy receives one exposure plus conductive bonus
all clients receive identical resulting checksum

name: Shortcut by demolition
description: Fragile structural wall separates two rooms.
given: A solid 4 HP wall blocks a valid optional shortcut.
then: wall_break and optional breach_route emit once

name: Shared destination tie
description: Two allied characters want same empty tile.
given: Alice and Bob both have 3 AP and same d6 initiative score.
when: Both submit MOVE to the same tile.
then: one actor remains in original cell

name: Last-chance stabilization
given: Adjacent medic and downed ally, medic carries a medkit.
when: Medic submits REVIVE before enemy phase resolves.
then: ally survives with ceil(20% max HP)

name: Paperwork boss solution
description: Marshal can be defeated by environmental interaction.
given: Counterweight and printer are reachable in the arena.
when: Players release counterweight, then hack printer successfully.

name: Duplicate request
description: Untrusted client re-sends a valid packet.
given: Accepted plan with nonce=41 on round 8.
when: Client sends identical SUBMIT_PLAN twice and tries to PICK_REWARD twice.

name: Host server resume
description: Snapshot at boss phase 2, hazard telegraphed.
given: Server writes revision 256 atomically then exits.
when: Server restarts and clients reconnect with tokens.

name: Procedural route survivability
given: One original background, no optional loot, all optional locks closed.
when: Generate floor for 100 fixed seeds and validate path.
then: no required path crosses forced lethal hazard

name: Offline in planning
when: 30 seconds pass; host uses Force Ready after 45 seconds.
then: reconnect restores same crawler and inventory
client cannot send plan as other player

name: Complete victory
description: Final uplink condition can be satisfied without hard-coded kill.
given: All floors resolved and final boss two-phase outcome complete.
when: Team redirects cables and authenticates signal shutdown.
then: solo and multiplayer share ending logic
